clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, Strahad Farsan sends Horde warlocks east in search of a lost grimoire. The Tome of the Cabal holds rites for summoning and binding a felhunter, and the search begins with cartographer Jorah Annison in the Undercity.

Strahad Farsan says a felhunter takes more than ordinary fel magic to summon. These predators feed on magical energies and resist standard summoning circles. An initiate needs specialized circles and an ancient grimoire called the Tome of the Cabal. The first order of warlocks to bind a felhunter without outside aid wrote the book. Its rites and seals show how to enslave such a dangerous demon.

Copies of the Tome of the Cabal have long been lost to warlocks in Kalimdor, so Strahad sends his student across the sea to Jorah Annison in the Undercity. Annison works as a royal cartographer, mapping Lordaeron, but knows a great deal about ancient and obscure texts. He admits that he despises mapmaking and hungers for rare histories, occult narratives, and treatises on dark magic.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It will take more than a simple summoning circle to bring forth a felhunter for you to challenge.

My three acolytes and I will assist in creating the magic circles. You require a copy of the Tome of the Cabal, which has been lost to us for some time. It was written by the first group of warlocks to summon a felhunter unaided.
Perhaps Jorah Annison can help you with this. He's employed as a cartographer in the Undercity these days, but still knows more of ancient texts than any I know.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Map making! Pictures, estimations of reality. I have no use for such things.
In books, narrative, description! That is where truth lies. I would trade all the maps in this store for one book on the rise of necromancy, or a tale of the Dark Lady's triumph.
